subject: Reseller integration + hybrid marketplace approach
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@cloudone-partner.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Whitmore <tom.whitmore@resellco.com>
Date: Sun, 03 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Reseller integration + hybrid marketplace approach

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for taking the time last week. ResellCo is excited to pilot a hybrid approach where they act as a value-added reseller for Redwood in North America while also listing a co-branded offering in AWS Marketplace and GCP Marketplace (we'd like to keep Azure optional for phase 2).

The ask: can Redwood provide a short mutual action plan that covers 1) marketplace listing requirements and asset owners for AWS/GCP, 2) reseller contract / SOW template we can start from, and 3) technical onboarding for our managed deployment variant (SSO, billing integration, entitlements)?

Attached is a one-page summary from ResellCo (reseller_intro.pdf) and our preferred timeline: market-ready in ~10 weeks.

Would love a 30-min sync early next week to align owners.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Partnerships, CloudOne

--
Attachments referenced: reseller_intro.pdf (pdf)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@cloudone-partner.com>
Cc: Tom Whitmore <tom.whitmore@resellco.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 03 Oct 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reseller integration + hybrid marketplace approach

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear summary and timeline. Happy to lead the mutual action plan and coordinate internally.

Quick draft of next steps from our side:
- Marketplace listing owners: Karthik (channel programs) for AWS/GCP listing intake; Marcus (solutions) will own technical evidence and listing artifacts; Vanessa (partnerships ops) will own commercial/lead routing and co-sell commitments.
- We will share a Redwood marketplace checklist and preferred asset pack (images, doc, pricing SKU mapping) by Wednesday.
- Legal/Sales to iterate a short reseller SOW: I’ll attach our starter SOW (reseller_SOW_v1.pdf). Please flag any major redlines.
- Technical onboarding: we need a short runbook from ResellCo for entitlements/SAML and a sandbox account for marketplace integration testing.

Can we do a 30-min alignment call on Tuesday 10/5 10:00–10:30 PT? If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite and a shared Drive folder for artifacts.

Thanks,
Priyom
Senior Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: reseller_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf); marketplace-listing-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reseller integration + hybrid marketplace approach

Looping in a few quick notes from ops/legal perspective:
- Marketplace artifacts we need per cloud: product listing copy, 2 screenshots, short demo video link, security evidence (SOC2 cert), and pricing SKU mapping. Marcus, can you confirm the demo video timeline?
- Lead routing: ResellCo wants first-touch attribution in HubSpot. Priyom, if we accept, we need HubSpot workflow and TTL for handbacks defined ahead of listing.
- Legal: short reseller SOW is fine to start; legal prefers a 45-day review cycle for any changes. We'll aim to have an initial SOW review by 10/12.

I'll take the owner for pricing SKU mapping and coordinate with finance. Marcus, Karthik — please provide ETA on technical checklist and listing intake form by Wednesday EOD.

-Vanessa
Head of Partnerships Ops, Redwood Inference

--
(Internal quick replies often follow as 1-line acknowledges.)

From: Tom Whitmore <tom.whitmore@resellco.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@cloudone-partner.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 06 Oct 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reseller integration + hybrid marketplace approach

Priyom / team — thanks for the clarity and the SOW. We reviewed reseller_SOW_v1.pdf and have three non-material asks that legal will circulate as redlines (pricing confidentiality clause, billing flow, and indemnity thresholds). Expect the redlines in the next 48 hours.

We can provide the sandbox tenant and SAML metadata by Friday 10/08. For the onboarding call, 10/12 at 10:00 PT works for our technical lead (please send calendar invite).
